h: Dutch-born Serie A star reportedly agrees to play for the Super Eagles
p: A Netherlands-born player in Italy's Serie A has reportedly agreed to represent Nigeria at senior level. The Nigeria Football Federation has not yet confirmed the switch or the player's eligibility paperwork.
more: Nigeria has been widening its search for dual-nationality players.
